عَرَمْرَمٌ Hard, strong, or vehement; (K, TA;) applied to anything. (TA.) ―
-b2- And Numerous; applied to an army; (S, K, TA;) or, as some
say, to anything. (TA.) ―
-b3- And, applied to a man, Having a strong degree of عُجْمَة [i. e. impotence, or difficulty, in speech, or utterance; or barbarousness, or vitiousness, therein; or in speaking Arabic].
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
